# third_party

Upstream code is cloned here, not committed (see `.gitignore`).

```bash
git clone https://github.com/VoxoTech/PiDAR.git third_party/PiDAR
```

PiDAR is the starting point for `src/lidar_scanning/rig/` and `registration/`.
Note which upstream commit you build against in `docs/decision_log.md`.
